Codex review: needs changes before merge. ## What this changes This PR opens named-agent chats immediately, adds conversational onboarding, and simplifies agent selection and Claws discovery. **Example:** Create an agent named Scout and choose Researcher. - **Before:** New agent opens Crestodian’s creation flow. - **After:** Scout’s chat opens immediately with a greeting, followed by a plain-text role question and a tailored research follow-up. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Useful, source-supported work with strong behavioral evidence and no concrete introduced finding; failed exact-head checks still require attribution before landing. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** ✨ media proof bonus | Sufficient (screenshot): Inspected screenshots and supplied isolated-Gateway results cover the named dialog, immediate chat, saved greeting, plain-text role question, tailored follow-up, and reload ordering; the public-WebSocket test supplies forbidden-principal provider-effect evidence. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Feature · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Creating another agent redirects users away from their intended chat and delays useful feedback. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction provides immediate named-chat feedback, conversational onboarding, and simpler navigation; no additional product approval is required. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 1 item remains** This PR delivers an approved redesign that current main does not provide; no concrete introduced defect was found, but two exact-head CI failures remain unattributed. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `6ca42753c192be9ef1575e9d476f01a505eb3e3a` ## Before merge - [ ] **Complete next step** - Inspect the two failed checks’ detailed output and classify each against the pinned base; repair only failures caused by this PR. ## Findings None. ### Provenance - `Runtime, metadata, and transcript internals`: original intent not found (unknown: Local path-history searches found relevant refactors, but unavailable historical blobs prevented complete changed-line provenance; no introduction claim is made for uncovered lines.)
Agent review details ### How this fits together The Control UI presents provisional creation state while Gateway agent, config, session, and inference owners validate and persist the agent and conversation. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Agent selector] --> B[Named creation dialog] B --> C[Provisional chat] B --> D[Gateway creation owner] D --> E[Inference verification] D --> F[Agent and session persistence] F --> G[Authorized onboarding turn] G --> C ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep creation in the existing agent and session owners, with display-only provisional chat state and shared catalog presentation. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? This is a feature redesign; current-main source confirms the prior Crestodian navigation, and supplied real-Gateway evidence demonstrates the replacement flow. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The inspected implementation coherently reuses existing creation, transcript, authority, recovery, and catalog owners rather than creating a parallel backend. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [7d732724b773](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7d732724b77369bc8627001a1cad3a5a9a49c4b2). ### Provenance checked - `Agents overview and selector` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/141097: The roster-first page made configured agents and their conversations discoverable; this PR explicitly replaces that overview with selector-based access and discovery-only Claws.) - `Agent navigation and pins` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174984: The earlier change emphasized agent navigation and quick access; this PR deliberately replaces pin controls with compact rows and direct settings actions.) - `Memory indexing lifecycle` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174718: Cold startup avoids opening every memory index while reload resumes watched indexing; the PR narrows reload restoration to previously demanded configured agents.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Current-main behavior:** The fetched main revision still routes the selector’s new-agent action to Crestodian; the named-dialog flow remains distinct work. ([`ui/src/components/app-sidebar-agent-menu.tsx`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/7d732724b77369bc8627001a1cad3a5a9a49c4b2/ui/src/components/app-sidebar-agent-menu.tsx), [7d732724b773](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7d732724b77369bc8627001a1cad3a5a9a49c4b2)) - **Creation and authority ownership:** Inference verification checks current mutation authority and active config before persistence; detached onboarding retains operator-run authority and releases it after the chat owner completes. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/agents.ts:206`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/6ca42753c192be9ef1575e9d476f01a505eb3e3a/src/gateway/server-methods/agents.ts#L206), [6ca42753c192](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6ca42753c192be9ef1575e9d476f01a505eb3e3a)) - **Forbidden-principal proof:** The supplied public-WebSocket integration exercises an authorized creator, refuses a read-only creator before persistence or provider I/O, and revokes the detached creator before resuming the real chat handler, asserting rejection without another provider POST. ([`src/gateway/agents-create.inference-authority.integration.test.ts:281`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/6ca42753c192be9ef1575e9d476f01a505eb3e3a/src/gateway/agents-create.inference-authority.integration.test.ts#L281), [6ca42753c192](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6ca42753c192be9ef1575e9d476f01a505eb3e3a)) - **Inspected visual and live evidence:** Inspected the prepared before/after screenshots and later GitHub images showing the named dialog, ordinary-text role question, Researcher follow-up, and agent first after reload; Patrick’s live walkthrough is recorded at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/175291#issuecomment-6306293687. - **Stored-data upgrade:** The full PR body records a disposable v2026.10.5 upgrade retaining Scout’s name, session identity, original messages, and successful subsequent turn; the greeting uses the existing transcript format and creation transaction. ([`src/gateway/session-create-initial-assistant.ts:66`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/6ca42753c192be9ef1575e9d476f01a505eb3e3a/src/gateway/session-create-initial-assistant.ts#L66), [6ca42753c192](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6ca42753c192be9ef1575e9d476f01a505eb3e3a)) - **Exact-head CI failures:** checks-fast-baseline-ratchets and checks-ui (3/3) failed on the reviewed head. Ratchet annotations name paths outside this diff; detailed logs redirect to a blocked storage host, so neither failure is attributed to this PR. ([6ca42753c192](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/6ca42753c192be9ef1575e9d476f01a505eb3e3a)) ### PR surface PR surface statistics unavailable: the file list is incomplete. ### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **Creation protocol additions** | 2 optional request fields | agentId separates internal identity from display name, and onboarding requests verification and initial conversation creation. | | **Browser persistence** | 1 automatic preference field | sidebarRecentlyCreatedAgentId retains roster ordering after reload without adding a user-facing configuration control. | ### Labels Label changes: - add `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: ClawSweeper has contributor-facing work open and is waiting for author action. - remove `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: Current PR status label is `status: ⏳ waiting on author`. Label justifications: - `P2`: This improves agent creation and navigation without evidence of an urgent production outage. - `rating: 🐚 platinum hermit`: Overall readiness is 🐚 platinum hermit; proof is 🦞 diamond lobster and patch quality is 🐚 platinum hermit. - `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: ClawSweeper has contributor-facing work open and is waiting for author action. - `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. - `proof: 📸 screenshot`: Contributor real behavior proof includes screenshot evidence. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab. Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality; ✨ marks media proof (a screenshot, video, or linked artifact) that directly shows the changed behavior. ### Workflow ClawSweeper edits this one comment on every review. Comment `@clawsweeper re-review` for a fresh review only. Repair and merge execution lanes are retired. ### History

The review fixes preserve one creation attempt across uncertain Gateway responses/reconnects, recover an agent whose config was saved before runtime application failed, and disable creation with an inline explanation when the connection lacks `agents.create`/`operator.admin`. A correlated rejection plus authoritative config absence is required before allowing a fresh ID.

The comparison below uses the real production UI bundle with the same synthetic read-only Gateway fixture and 1440×900 dark viewport: before `fa93cabf0fd3`, after `41eb78cda429`. Both captures have no page errors. The disabled action keeps its explanation readable; an admin connection still has an enabled creation action.

![Read-only creation access before and after](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6a816bf2-5d0b-4a28-b2bc-b991a79e2585)

Validation: 97 backend cases; 46 creation/recovery/access source cases plus 14 fixture cases; 29 sidebar/navigation E2E cases and six browser-menu cases. Core/UI types, gateway-method test types, scoped lint/stylelint, generated boot manifest, and production UI build pass. Chat/New boot payloads remain below their enforced budgets; startup size has the existing advisory warning. The canonical latest-stable upgrade-survivor check is running separately; broad CI status remains owned by GitHub checks.


### Current CI repair follow-up
Published `19bcf7c3b479f65c79fb9849a8735bab660ab50b` fixes the new skills fixture finding: direct worker mock calls, with the metadata-refresh case, services test types and lint passing. The earlier access/uncertain-write findings remain fixed; this test-only batch preserves the UI proof above.

It also repairs the merged mobile-layout fixture, waits for the real menu entry animation before strict WebKit geometry comparison, enforces memory cache capacity at transaction commit (the contract introduced in #175224), and seeds a transcript for reclamation concurrency after #175091's empty-delete optimization. Focused checks pass; cache recovery is 23/23 and the Layout case passes in Chromium/WebKit. The unresolved original CI failures remain described in the PR; passing local replay is not called a fix.

Compatibility evidence remains bounded: existing config/transcript and older browser-preference contracts pass, and no database schema migration is introduced. Removing the overview route is intentional. The latest-stable full survivor scenario is still unrun because the shared Docker VM lacks safe capacity; its internal runner is not a supported host substitute. This is a recorded proof gap, not a claimed successful upgrade.

The paired image uses the same 1440×1000 light viewport at +5.001/+5.002 seconds. The 38.4-second recording plays at real speed. Gray masks cover private account, branch and model metadata only; raw originals and timing records are retained. This lane exercised normal creation and return/reload, not a repeat of the separate access-denial and uncertain-response tests. The temporary proof Gateway is stopped; protected Gateways remain healthy.

nodes.body:
Live proof for the named-agent onboarding flow on `eb19b4d18ba`:

- The creation dialog combines a display-name field with the existing Blobster picker.
- The new agent opens its own chat, then presents a single-choice Ask User card with the four existing roles.
- After choosing a role, the agent asks an open-ended question for the user's specific goal.

The attached screenshots are cropped to exclude local workspace and model details. The earlier selector/creation baseline remains in the PR description.

![Agent creation dialog with the Blobster picker and name field](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0e5c7066-5553-4677-a168-3c382132adf9)

![Single-select Ask User role question](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f1c0f025-5c31-4942-ae88-de5fd67ab66a)

![Agent follow-up tailored to the selected research role](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/98a3a931-6c5d-4636-a244-184c1fe15515)

nodes.body:
Exact-head live proof for `a3d1bc623690` on the isolated direct Gateway preview (no OCM). This supersedes the earlier Ask User recording: Patrick chose a plain-text opening role question.

**Before:** New Agent opened [Crestodian's role prompt](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bd2cf8fd-7b2a-47f6-b91e-e97c4b6eaf7f).

**After:** Create new agent opens the name-and-Blobster dialog, puts the named agent first in the roster, and enters its own chat immediately. A saved greeting appears, then the agent asks in ordinary chat text for one of four roles or a custom role. It uses no Ask User card. After the user replies “Researcher,” the agent asks what topic or question to investigate. The Claws page uses the shared page header and shows discovery only.

nodes.body:
Exact-head direct-Gateway proof for `2ae4730cb18301f1adf509db71e2ec6ad4c9757b` (isolated Tailnet preview, no OCM):

Before, **New agent** opened [Crestodian's role list](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bd2cf8fd-7b2a-47f6-b91e-e97c4b6eaf7f). After, it opens the name-and-Blobster dialog:

![Named agent creation dialog](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bf70a4ad-0b2f-4318-a15b-1b51e4209fb5)

Clicking Create entered the named agent's chat in 156 ms and showed its saved greeting in 261 ms. The agent then asked the four-role question in ordinary chat text, without an Ask User card:

![Plain-text role question in the new agent chat](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3eb3607f-4cdf-4510-ac1b-6020a939b4a3)

After the user replied `Researcher`, the agent asked what to investigate rather than proposing another agent creation:

![Researcher detail follow-up](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/19403d96-f78c-4a25-a303-538d31cb6ee4)

The created agent stayed first in the selector after reloading the same browser context:

![New agent first in the selector after reload](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5b3cd07b-5000-43ff-acc3-13f879215064)

The full browser recording also shows the selector, dialog, immediate chat, role question, reply, reload, and Claws route:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5c00654b-e9a0-4deb-904c-eca778855005

The model-generated role question took 59 seconds on this loaded local Qwen fixture; the saved greeting was immediate. The earlier first preview interaction overlapped the Vite rebuild and reset the draft name, so this proof was recorded after the rebuild settled. The stable run retained the name and the input node throughout avatar selection.

nodes.body:
Exact-head live proof for `a546d89b080`: authenticated direct Gateway preview, no OCM. The recording follows the full manual test: open Create new agent, choose a name and Blobster, enter the new chat immediately, see the saved greeting and plain-text four-role question, reply “Researcher,” receive a goal-detail follow-up, reload and see the agent first in the selector, then open Claws.

Observed: chat visible in 68 ms; greeting in 171 ms; plain-text question completed in 15.9 seconds on the local Qwen fixture; new agent first after reload; Claws page loaded. The opening turn had no Ask User card or premature goal question. The model-generated role question is not part of the earlier five-second target, which Patrick set aside.

Screenshots: named dialog; role question; selector after reload. Video: complete walkthrough.
